evidence.tests: go test ./... and go test -race ./... pass including independent tests
evidence.lint: go vet ./... and git diff --check pass
evidence.build: go build ./... passes; compiler performs typecheck
evidence.independent: Empty/repeated ReadFrom, discard + tee, partial downstream write error and tee writer error preserve count/error/body

limitations: Go1.27.1 Linux only; other supported versions not executed
